posts.text:
By acquiring the IP rights of the Preakness, we've secured its future here for decades to come — and ensured Maryland keeps control of this multi-billion dollar industry.

The Preakness Stakes is a cornerstone of Maryland’s history, culture, and economy. This acquisition ensures that it remains a world-class event, managed in the best interest of our racing community and taxpayers, and preserves Maryland's position as a key power player in the Triple Crown for generations to come.

Our law enforcement officers like Top Cop Awardee Richard Krause work tirelessly and sacrifice so much to keep Marylanders safe. 

Partnership brings progress and nothing else ever will.

posts.text:
Somewhere in Maryland, there are children who will one day cure a disease at the National Institutes of Health or build the next great telescope at Goddard.

But we have to put science within their reach.

The Maryland Science Center has done that for over 15 million people –  and I’m proud that Maryland’s helping to replace their aging HVAC system and keep this building running strong.

In this moment of fear for our immigrant communities, we will not stand by while bad actors defraud our neighbors.

Not today. Not tomorrow. Not ever.

When a family on the Shore needs answers, they will get them from a qualified attorney – not from someone preying on fear and profiting off of it.
